setup.title: Turn on the statistics
setup.step1: 1. Add this to Traefik's static configuration (the Static config view can edit it). The entry point must NOT be published: do not list port 8082 in the container's ports.
setup.step2: 2. Give the worker the address of that entry point, on the same Docker network (worker environment):
setup.step3: 3. Restart Traefik and the worker, then use "Test the connection".
visitors.title: Visitors
visitors.privacy: From Traefik's access log, kept for 7 days. Addresses are personal data: they are shown as networks unless you hold the right to see them whole. Query strings are never kept. Paths are kept as Traefik logged them: they can contain identifiers, so only share this panel with people you trust with them.
visitors.masked: Addresses are grouped by network (the last part is hidden).
